title: Sale Banner Maker for Square Offer Images | AIVideosUGC
description: Move stock with a sale image that leaves clean space for your offer. One product photo becomes a square banner; add the discount and dates yourself.
h1: Sale Banner Maker with Room for the Offer
lead: A discount with no clear product image disappears in the feed. This sale banner maker turns one product photo into a square scene with empty space for the offer you add later.
steps_h2: How to Make a Sale Banner in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Upload the product, leave an open area, then add the real offer after download.

steps.d: Start with one clear photo of the sale product, with the whole item showing. The scene comes from that photo, not from a typed discount.
Describe the setting and ask for empty space beside the product. Leave the percent, the code, and the end date out.
Add the confirmed discount, code and end date in your editor, then post. Read every number on a phone preview first.

faq.q: Why doesn't the banner include my discount text?
faq.a: Generated lettering can mix up words and numbers, and a wrong price on a sale ad is a real problem. Add the offer yourself so every number matches the promotion you approved.

faq.q: What size is the sale image?
faq.a: Square by default, which fits a Facebook or Instagram feed post. For a wide website header, place the image on a wider background in your design tool.

faq.q: Can I reuse one scene for a different offer?
faq.a: Yes. Add the offer as text after download. The same scene can carry a percent-off line in one ad and another approved line in a second ad.

faq.q: Can I make a vertical sale story from it?
faq.a: The template produces a square image. If you need a tall Story or Reel, put that square on a tall 9:16 background after download.

faq.q: Where should the discount code go?
faq.a: Put the code in the open area as editable text, then read the full offer on a phone-sized preview. Do not ask the tool to write the code into the photo.

faq.q: How many credits does a sale photo use?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, the cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns those credits. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads, pages and posts. You are responsible for the offer terms and for what the ad must say.

faq.q: What happens when the sale ends?
faq.a: Delete, pause, or replace the offer text you added so an old date or code is never shown. The product scene can stay for a later promotion or as a plain listing image.

faq.q: Can I start from a Black Friday scene and change the holiday later?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the product scene and swap the headline. Seasonal campaign notes live on [Black Friday ad creatives](page:occ-black-friday).

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan for a sale banner?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. A sale photo is 24 credits, shown before you start.

faq.q: Can I batch sale photos or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same scene across a catalog, or send photos from your own software (API). Each photo spends 24 credits from your plan. A failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can a generated person appear in the sale scene?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a generated person to wear or hold the product, or keep the product alone. The person is generated. The discount is still typed by you after download.
